svg.title: Beyond the Horizon - A2 design proof
svg.text: Exploring the Unknown: From the Deepest Oceans to the Distant Stars
FIVE ENVIRONMENTS. ONE QUESTION: IS THE DISCOVERY WORTH THE RISK?
Protection reduces risk; it cannot remove it.
BELOW THE SURFACE / LIFE IN THE DARK
ROVs let people study the deep ocean from a ship.
Livingston Island / Anne Dirkse / CC BY-SA 4.0
ICE CORES / CLUES TO PAST CLIMATE
Air bubbles in ice preserve samples of the past atmosphere.
Queensland / Robert Kerton, CSIRO / CC BY 3.0
Respect local communities and their knowledge.
A summit is optional. Returning safely matters more.
Exploration helps us understand our world and discover what lies beyond it. Although it involves
risks and costs, responsible exploration creates knowledge and opportunities for future
Scientific exploration asks questions, collects evidence, and shares knowledge. It has a research purpose; tourism and recreation have other goals.
STAY CURIOUS / PLAN CAREFULLY / RESPECT NATURE
SOURCES: NASA / NOAA / BRITISH ANTARCTIC SURVEY / SMITHSONIAN / KEW / NPS / RGS
A GRADE 10 ENGLISH EXPLORATION PROJECT / ALBANIA
